_doc: ASN -> {consumer_isp | hosting_dc | unclassified}, used by ooni_gap.py.
Rules are keyword matches (word-boundary, case-insensitive) against the RIPE holder
name resolved at runtime, so buckets can be audited against a name rather than a bare
AS number. Rules are evaluated in order; hosting first, so a hosting provider whose
name contains an operator-ish token cannot land on the consumer side.
METHOD RULE, and it matters: an ASN is classified on IDENTITY EVIDENCE ONLY -- its
holder name, its website, what the company sells. Never on its measured block rate.
Deciding buckets after looking at rates is how you manufacture a gap. Anything whose
identity is genuinely unclear stays unclassified and is reported with its own pooled
rate, so a reader can see whether the classification choice moved the headline.
consumer_isp is scoped to operators that sell service to end users in Russia. These
are the networks TSPU is installed at, which is the population Correction 3 is about.
hosting_dc is scoped to hosting/VPS/cloud providers -- the vantage a cheap RU VPS

rules.why: Generic hosting tokens plus RU hosting/VPS/cloud brands. 'server', 'hosting', 'vds' and 'vps' are business descriptions, not incidental words.
Russian operators selling access to end users. Federal operators and their regional subsidiaries (which keep the parent's name in the RIPE holder field), plus large regional ISPs.

_doc: Per-ASN decisions where the name alone is not enough. Each carries the evidence used.
Rate was not consulted for any of these.

override_evidence.9123: TimeWeb-AS / JSC TIMEWEB - timeweb.ru, major RU shared-hosting and VPS provider (PeeringDB website field).
override_evidence.198610: BEGET-AS / Beget LLC - beget.com, major RU hosting provider (PeeringDB website field).
override_evidence.208677: CLOUDRU-AS / 'Cloud Technologies' LLC trading as Cloud.ru - RU public cloud.
override_evidence.209641: I-SERVERS-EAST / IHOR HOSTING LTD - hosting per holder name. Its PeeringDB record ('Educational/Research', unrelated contact name) is stale and was not used.
override_evidence.48347: MTW-AS / JSC Mediasoft ekspert - mtw.ru hosting provider; RIPE remarks carry lg.mtw.ru, PeeringDB website https://mtw.ru.

deliberately_unclassified._doc: Ambiguous identities, left out of BOTH buckets. Listed so the choice is visible rather than silent.
deliberately_unclassified.8242: INTELWAY-AS / Digital Solutions LLC - matched a generic 'digital' token in an early draft; nothing establishes hosting vs ISP. Not in PeeringDB.
deliberately_unclassified.50716: TELECOMRUNET / Telecom.ru Ltd - carries upstream/customer remarks like a carrier, but the business is unclear. Third-largest ASN by volume, so it is called out explicitly.
deliberately_unclassified.35598: INETCOM CARRIER LLC - inetcom.ru; regional ISP or transit carrier, not resolved.
